source_block.parva: Udyoga Parva · Krishna’s peace embassy to Hastinapura · five villages · refusal · cosmic form · road to war
source_block.divergence: BORI CE / Debroy place Krishna’s embassy, the five-village offer, Duryodhana’s refusal, the plot to seize Krishna, and the cosmic-form revelation in Udyoga. Ganguli’s vulgate English maps the same sabha beats. Gita Press Gorakhpur tells the same embassy–offer–refusal–form arc under its Udyoga numbering. Beats agree: camps → mission → journey → court → offer → refuse → form → return → closing resolve. Exact wording of the ‘needle’s point’ refusal varies by recension; this episode keeps the hard refusal without gore.
source_block.chosen: Gita Press Gorakhpur + BORI overlap for the embassy–refusal–form itself. Debroy for BORI beat map. Ganguli for English sabha wording.
source_block.notes: Not TV. Comic-mythology only. Krishna face/body = Ep 09 lock (pitambar, peacock, garland). Cosmic form = tasteful radiance, not horror. Never attach Ep01 plate-wide-gold or this episode’s plate-wide-gold as Imagine refs.
